name: Sheet-Pan Chimichurri Chicken

ingredients.name: flat-leaf parsley, leaves and tender stems only
cilantro, leaves and tender stems only
kosher salt, plus more as needed
red wine vinegar, plus more as needed
boneless skinless chicken thighs, about 4 to 6
kosher salt, plus more as needed
red bell pepper, cut into 1-inch pieces
red onion, peeled and cut into 1/2-inch wedges

instructions.primary_message: For the Chimichurri: In the bowl of a food processor, pulse parsley, cilantro, oregano, garlic, salt, and red pepper flakes until finely ground, about 30 seconds. Add olive oil and vinegar and pulse until just combined; season to taste with additional salt and vinegar.

In a large bowl, toss chicken thighs with honey and 1/3 cup of chimichurri to evenly coat. Refrigerate for at least 1 hour or up to 8 hours. Place remaining chimichurri in an airtight container; refrigerate until ready to use. (Alternatively, chicken can be marinated in a zip-top bag. Place chicken and 1/3 cup dressing in a zip-top bag, seal, and massage chicken through plastic until evenly coated with dressing.)

Line a 13-by-18-inch rimmed baking sheet with paper towels. Arrange cut zucchini in a single layer and sprinkle evenly with 1/4 teaspoon salt. Let sit to allow zucchini to release excess moisture, about 15 minutes. Firmly pat dry with paper towels or a clean kitchen towel; set aside.
Adjust oven rack to upper third position of oven, about 6 inches below the heating element, and heat broiler to high.

Remove chicken from marinade; on a 13-by-18-inch rimmed baking sheet, space thighs out so there is plenty of space between them; discard marinade. Arrange zucchini, cherry tomatoes red pepper, and onions around chicken. Drizzle vegetables with olive oil and season evenly with a pinch of salt.

Broil until chicken is dark golden brown and vegetables are just beginning to char, about 10 minutes. Using tongs, flip chicken and vegetables, and broil until vegetables are tender and chicken is lightly charred and measures 185°F on an instant-read thermometer, 7 to 10 minutes. (See notes.)
Serve with reserved chimichurri, rice, flatbread, or roasted potatoes, if desired.

schema_metadata.keywords: sheet pan chicken, sheet pan chicken thighs, chimichurri, chimichurri chicken

description: This tender, juicy sheet-pan chicken is slathered in a zesty green cilantro chimichurri and surrounded by vegetables.
notes:
Total time, including resting: 1 hr 40 min.

Optional or for serving: Cooked long-grain rice; flatbreads, such as pita; or roasted potatoes, for serving (optional)

Notes: 1 tablespoon plus 1 teaspoon dried oregano can be used in place of fresh oregano.The strength of a broiler can vary greatly based on the model of your oven. It may take up to 14 minutes per side for your chicken to properly brown.

Make-ahead and storage: The chimichurri can be made up to 3 days in advance and refrigerated in an airtight container.Leftovers can be refrigerated in an airtight container for up to 3 days.
author: Zola Gregory
